ai_positioning.summary: TCOM intègre l'IA dans ses produits (WenDao AI assistant, Trip.Planner) et ses processus opérationnels, mais reste prudente face aux risques réglementaires et de fiabilité.

evidence.text: Completed filings or registrations for Ctrip mobile application and relevant AI products, such as WenDAO AI assistant and Trip.Planner
PRC government requiring providers of generative artificial intelligence services and algorithmic recommendation services to complete filings or registrations
AI-enabled outputs are incorrect or perceived as unreliable, we may face increased customer complaints and loss of trust in our brands and platforms
EU Artificial Intelligence Act was signed by European Union legislators in June 2024, which offers a classification for AI systems with different requirements and obligations
If we fail to effectively address these challenges, we may not be successful in adopting, implementing or incorporating artificial intelligence effectively into our product offerings
